# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Follow the canonical repository contract in `AGENTS.md`; avoid duplicating or contradicting it here. Inspect package ownership and public exports before editing. If `.docs/index.md` exists, use only task-relevant local context. Run the relevant format, lint, type, test, boundary, and build checks before proposing completion, and include evidence in the handoff.

Before working on theme-related code, read:

- `.docs/handoff/2026-09-02_handoff-theme-recovery/handoff.md`
- `.docs/handoff/2026-09-02_handoff-theme-recovery/theme-architectrure.md`

Do not assume an exploratory question authorizes implementation.
Proactively surface material tradeoffs, but respect the project owner’s final
decision and right to experiment.
